text.zh: 旧 /api/datasets、会话 load-dataset / save-dataset 仍保留兼容。它们面向 Registry，不能简单地把路径替换为 personal-datasets：两个目录的 ID 和加载、删除语义不同。旧个人构图路径是例外，其 construction 系列允许只替换路径前缀。
text.en: Legacy /api/datasets and session load-dataset / save-dataset endpoints remain compatible. They address the registry, so replacing their prefixes with personal-datasets is not a general migration: IDs and loading/deletion semantics differ. Legacy personal construction routes are aliases and do allow a prefix-only substitution.

text.zh: 登录用户可调用 GET /api/dataset-api-migration 获取结构化迁移说明。现有兼容声明没有安排删除日期；智能体的 list_datasets、load_dataset、save_as_dataset 工具继续维护。
text.en: Authenticated users can request GET /api/dataset-api-migration for structured migration guidance. No removal date has been scheduled. Agent tools list_datasets, load_dataset, and save_as_dataset remain maintained.

description.zh: 从图数据、标签与划分出发，理解四类图学习任务的模型结构、训练目标、评估协议，以及模型保存和推理流程。
description.en: Understand four graph-learning tasks through their data, labels, splits, model architectures, training objectives, evaluation protocols, saved models, and inference workflows.

text.zh: 图机器学习通过 train、infer 和 visualize_model_architecture 工具使用。节点分类、链接预测与预训练读取会话的活动单图；图分类读取独立的多图数据集。这里的节点分类回答‘这个节点属于哪一类’，链接预测估计节点对的连接分数，图分类预测整张图的标签，预训练则生成后续任务可复用的节点嵌入向量。
text.en: Use graph machine learning through train, infer, and visualize_model_architecture. Node classification, link prediction, and pretraining read the session's active single graph; graph classification reads a separate collection of graphs. These tasks predict node classes, score node pairs, predict graph-level labels, and produce reusable node embeddings, respectively.

rows.zh: 必填 model：GCN / GAT / SAGE；单图节点特征与标签
rows.en: Required model: GCN / GAT / SAGE; single-graph node features and labels

rows.zh: 交叉熵；输出节点类别与 softmax 概率
rows.en: Cross-entropy; node classes and softmax probabilities

rows.zh: 必填 model：GCN / GAT / SAGE；单图结构
rows.en: Required model: GCN / GAT / SAGE; single-graph structure

rows.zh: 正负边二元交叉熵；输出节点对分数与连接概率
rows.en: Binary cross-entropy on positive and negative edges; pair scores and connection probabilities

rows.zh: 必填 model：GCN / GAT / SAGE；HIV / PCBA 多图数据集
rows.en: Required model: GCN / GAT / SAGE; HIV / PCBA graph collections

rows.zh: 忽略缺失标签的二元交叉熵；输出图级单任务或多任务预测
rows.en: Binary cross-entropy excluding missing labels; single-task or multi-task graph predictions

rows.zh: 不要求 model；读取单图结构，在 CPU 上训练
rows.en: No model required; single-graph structure, trained on CPU

rows.zh: 随机游走正负上下文学习；保存节点嵌入向量
rows.en: Positive/negative random-walk context learning; saved node embeddings

rows.zh: 必填 model：GCN / GAT / SAGE；单图特征与结构
rows.en: Required model: GCN / GAT / SAGE; single-graph features and structure

rows.zh: 这些名称目前共享同一个 GNN 边重构训练分支
rows.en: These names currently share the same GNN edge-reconstruction training branch

text.zh: GCN、GAT、SAGE 是可提交的模型名称，SAGE 对应 GraphSAGE。pretrain 必须填写 method；其余三个监督任务必须填写 model。GNN 预训练方法名称不意味着已经分别实现图增广对比学习、特征掩码或掩码自动编码器，选择方法时应以本页描述的实际损失函数为准。
text.en: GCN, GAT, and SAGE are accepted model names; SAGE denotes GraphSAGE. Pretraining requires method, while all three supervised tasks require model. The GNN pretraining method names do not imply separate implementations of graph-augmentation contrastive learning, feature masking, or masked autoencoders; use the actual objectives described here to interpret them.

text.zh: 设 N 为节点数、E 为存储边数、F 为输入特征维度、D 为输出嵌入维度。模型读取 GraphData 的节点顺序与 edge_index，不先转成文本再重建图。消息传递使用形状为 [2, E] 的边索引；语义为无向的图会生成双向边索引副本，供邻居聚合使用，不改写活动图。边权重和边属性当前没有传入这三个 GNN 骨干网络。
text.en: Let N be the node count, E the stored edge count, F the input feature dimension, and D the embedding dimension. Models use GraphData's node order and edge_index directly, without converting the graph to text. Message passing uses a [2, E] edge index. Semantically undirected graphs receive a bidirectional copy for aggregation without modifying the active graph. Edge weights and edge attributes are currently not passed to the three GNN backbones.

rows.zh: 转换为 float32。[N] 扩展为 [N, 1]；高于二维时按节点展平为 [N, F]。已有特征不会自动标准化。
rows.en: Converted to float32. [N] becomes [N, 1]; tensors with more than two dimensions are flattened per node to [N, F]. Existing features are not automatically standardized.

rows.zh: 生成 [入度, 出度, 总度, 常数 1]，得到 [N, 4]；每列除以该列最大值与 1 中的较大者。
rows.en: Generate [in-degree, out-degree, total degree, constant 1] with shape [N, 4]; divide each column by the larger of its maximum and 1.

rows.zh: 标量类别值映射到连续类别索引；缺失标签不进入监督样本。训练需要足够的已标注节点和至少两个类别。
rows.en: Scalar class values are mapped to contiguous class indices. Missing labels are excluded from supervision. Training needs enough labeled nodes and at least two classes.

rows.zh: 沿类别维度取 argmax；行和为零的节点视为未标注。这是单标签分类路径，不是多标签节点分类。
rows.en: Take argmax across classes; zero-sum rows are treated as unlabeled. This is a single-label classification path, not multi-label node classification.

rows.zh: 使用 upstream_model_id 的嵌入模型.npy，按 node_names.json 中的节点名对齐；新图中未匹配的节点填零向量。
rows.en: Use embedding.npy from upstream_model_id, aligned by names in node_names.json; unmatched nodes in the new graph receive zero vectors.

text.zh: data.feature_source 默认是 graph。改为嵌入模型时，还必须给出同一会话作用域内的 upstream_model_id；上游模型必须实际保存了节点嵌入文件。这个选项复用的是输入特征，不会载入上游 GNN 权重继续优化，也不恢复优化器状态。节点名变化会影响对齐结果，因此复用前应检查名称一致性与缺失匹配数量。
text.en: data.feature_source defaults to graph. Setting it to embedding also requires an upstream_model_id in the same session scope, and that model must contain saved node embeddings. This reuses input features; it neither resumes the upstream GNN's weights nor restores optimizer state. Node-name changes affect alignment, so check naming consistency and missing matches before reuse.

title.zh: 节点分类：标签划分与训练
title.en: Node classification: labels, splits, and training

text.zh: 节点分类先生成 [N, F] 特征，再由 GNN 得到 [N, D] 嵌入，最后用线性分类头映射到 [N, C] 类别分数。每轮对整张图做一次训练前向传播，仅对训练节点的分数计算交叉熵并反向传播。优化完成后切换到评估模式，在同一张图上重新计算训练准确率与验证准确率，关闭 dropout 对评估的随机影响。
text.en: Node classification maps [N, F] features through a GNN to [N, D] embeddings, then applies a linear head to produce [N, C] class logits. Each epoch performs a full-graph training forward pass and computes cross-entropy only on training nodes. After optimization, evaluation mode recomputes training and validation accuracy on the same graph with dropout disabled.

items.zh: data.target_nodes 可将监督范围限制到指定节点名；无法识别或没有标签的节点不会成为有效监督样本。
items.en: data.target_nodes can restrict supervision to named nodes; unrecognized or unlabeled nodes are not usable supervised examples.

items.zh: 若图有 train_mask，训练集采用该掩码并与已标注节点相交。验证集优先采用 val_mask；没有 val_mask 时会使用 test_mask；两者都没有时使用其余已标注节点。
items.en: If train_mask exists, training uses its intersection with labeled nodes. Validation prefers val_mask, falls back to test_mask, and otherwise uses the remaining labeled nodes.

items.zh: 若图没有 train_mask，则用 seed 打乱已标注节点，按 train / (train + val) 划分。默认比例为 0.8 / 0.2；兼容字段 train_config.split.test 不参与此流程。
items.en: Without train_mask, labeled nodes are shuffled using seed and split by train / (train + val), defaulting to 0.8 / 0.2. The compatibility field train_config.split.test is not used by this flow.

items.zh: 随机划分仅用于该次训练，不会回写成图的 train_mask 或 val_mask。后续 infer 的 query.split 读取原图掩码，不能用它索引一份未持久化的随机划分。
items.en: Random splits are local to the training run and are not written into graph masks. infer query.split reads the original graph's masks and cannot retrieve an unpersisted random split.

text.zh: 模型选择指标是 val_acc。只有本轮验证准确率严格大于 best_val_acc + early_stop_min_delta 才更新最佳训练检查点；相同准确率不会因训练损失更低而替换检查点。训练结束后恢复最佳骨干网络与分类头，返回 train_loss、train_acc、val_acc、best_epoch、trained_epochs、stopped_early 等指标。若 test_mask 被用作验证集，这次运行没有独立的测试评估，应据实报告该评估协议。
text.en: Model selection uses val_acc. A checkpoint improves only when validation accuracy is strictly greater than best_val_acc + early_stop_min_delta; equal accuracy does not replace it for a lower training loss. Training restores the best backbone and head and reports train_loss, train_acc, val_acc, best_epoch, trained_epochs, and stopped_early. If test_mask served as validation, the run has no independent test evaluation; report that protocol explicitly.

title.zh: 链接预测：采样、解码与指标
title.en: Link prediction: sampling, decoding, and metrics

text.zh: 链接预测从图的逻辑边生成正样本，或读取 data.target_edges 中的节点名二元组；训练至少需要两条正边。正边经 seed 打乱后划分为训练与验证部分。验证负边从非自环、图中不存在的节点对中采样，固定使用 seed + 11 并去重；无向图会考虑反向边等价性。采样有尝试次数上限，因此稠密图可能得到少于请求数量的负样本。
text.en: Link prediction takes positive examples from logical graph edges or named pairs in data.target_edges; at least two positive edges are required. Positives are shuffled with seed and split into training and validation sets. Validation negatives are unique, non-self pairs absent from the graph, sampled with seed + 11 and undirected equivalence where applicable. Attempts are bounded, so dense graphs can yield fewer negatives than requested.

text.zh: 骨干网络输出节点嵌入 z，节点对的原始分数为 z[u] 与 z[v] 的内积，sigmoid 后得到 prob。每轮训练使用 PyG negative_sampling 生成负样本，损失为正边二元交叉熵与负边二元交叉熵之和。该内积解码器是对称的，即使原图是有向图，u→v 与 v→u 也得到相同分数；模型没有独立的关系类型或方向解码头。
text.en: The backbone produces node embeddings z. A pair's raw score is the dot product of z[u] and z[v], converted to prob with sigmoid. Each epoch uses PyG negative_sampling, and the loss sums binary cross-entropy for positive and negative edges. This decoder is symmetric: u→v and v→u have the same score even on a directed graph. There is no separate relation-type or directional decoder.

text.zh: 每轮在固定验证正负样本上计算 val_auc，并搜索分类阈值以提高验证准确率。分数种类较多时，阈值候选压缩为一组分位点。最佳检查点主要按 val_auc 选择，在 AUC 差值处于 min_delta 范围时再比较 val_acc；选中的 threshold 随模型保存。这里的 AUC 使用本模块的秩统计实现，与处理并列分数的其他评估库可能存在差异。
text.en: Each epoch computes val_auc on fixed validation positives and negatives and searches a threshold for validation accuracy. With many distinct scores, candidates are reduced to quantiles. Checkpoint selection primarily uses val_auc, breaking comparisons within min_delta using val_acc. The selected threshold is saved. AUC uses this module's rank-based implementation, which can differ from other libraries in how tied scores are handled.

text.zh: 这一训练流程只划分用于计算损失和指标的正边集合，GNN 的消息传递仍读取活动图完整的邻接关系，包括验证正边。因此这些指标不能直接当作‘从训练邻接中完全移除验证边’的链接预测基准结果。若目标是严格的未知边泛化实验，需要另行实现训练邻接隔离与一致的负样本协议。
text.en: This flow splits the positives used for loss and metrics, but GNN message passing still uses the active graph's complete adjacency, including validation positives. Its metrics are therefore not equivalent to a benchmark that removes validation edges from training adjacency. Strict unseen-edge generalization experiments require a separate adjacency-isolation and negative-sampling protocol.

title.zh: 预训练与嵌入向量复用

text.zh: Node2Vec 根据图结构采样随机游走，通过正负上下文损失学习节点向量。当前使用稀疏参数与 SparseAdam，计算固定在 CPU 上；指定 GPU 不会把这个分支变为 GPU 随机游走训练。walk_length、context_size、walks_per_node、num_negative_samples、p、q 控制游走与采样，批大小读取 algo_config.batch_size，默认 128，而不是图分类使用的 train_config.batch_size。
text.en: Node2Vec samples random walks and learns node vectors using positive and negative context losses. It uses sparse parameters and SparseAdam on CPU; selecting a GPU does not move this branch's walk training to the GPU. walk_length, context_size, walks_per_node, num_negative_samples, p, and q control sampling. Its batch size comes from algo_config.batch_size, default 128, rather than graph classification's train_config.batch_size.

text.zh: Node2Vec 默认 walk_length=20、context_size=10、walks_per_node=10、num_negative_samples=1、p=q=1；训练器在未传 embedding_dim 时使用 128。为避免不同任务默认值带来误解，示例显式填写嵌入维度。该分支运行完整 epochs，忽略 weight_decay 和早停选项；结束时保存最后一轮的嵌入模型.npy，不保存可继续训练的 Node2Vec 训练检查点。
text.en: Node2Vec defaults to walk_length=20, context_size=10, walks_per_node=10, num_negative_samples=1, and p=q=1; its trainer uses embedding_dim=128 when omitted. Examples set the dimension explicitly to avoid confusion between task defaults. This branch runs all epochs, ignores weight_decay and early-stopping options, and saves final embedding.npy without a resumable Node2Vec checkpoint.

text.zh: GNN 预训练读取图特征和完整边索引，用节点嵌入内积重构正边，并对负采样边计算二元交叉熵。已命名的 contrastive_learning、graph_contrastive_learning、mask_autoencoding、graph_mask_autoencoding 都执行这一流程；没有各自独立的视图增广、掩码率或重构特征损失。它使用 Adam，保存最终骨干网络与节点嵌入，不执行验证集选择或早停。
text.en: GNN pretraining reads graph features and the complete edge index, reconstructing positive edges with embedding dot products and applying binary cross-entropy to sampled negatives. contrastive_learning, graph_contrastive_learning, mask_autoencoding, and graph_mask_autoencoding all follow this flow; they have no separate view augmentation, masking ratio, or feature-reconstruction loss. It uses Adam and saves the final backbone and embeddings, without validation selection or early stopping.

text.zh: 预训练模型的 infer 是已保存嵌入向量的查询接口：按 query.nodes 返回训练时已有节点的向量，或者按 infer_config.limit 返回前若干项，默认 200。即使 GNN 预训练保存了骨干网络，当前推理路径也不会对新图重新执行 GNN 前向传播。要为更新后的图生成新的向量，需要重新运行预训练；要将这些向量用于节点分类或链接预测，可选择 data.feature_source=嵌入模型并填写上游 model_id。
text.en: Pretraining infer looks up saved embeddings: query.nodes selects nodes present during training, or infer_config.limit returns an initial subset, default 200. Even when a GNN checkpoint exists, this inference path does not run the GNN on a new graph. Rerun pretraining to generate embeddings for an updated graph; to use saved vectors for node classification or link prediction, set data.feature_source=embedding and provide the upstream model_id.

title.zh: 分子图分类的数据结构

text.zh: 图分类的数据单元是一张图，HIV 是 1 个二分类任务，PCBA 是 128 个二分类任务。load_graph_classification_dataset 读取会话上传目录中的 .pt 文件，dataset_profile 可设为 auto、hiv 或 pcba；数据集经校验后绑定到会话，并返回 dataset_id。它独立于活动单图：load_graph_classification_graph 可以抽取一张样本用于查看，但不会把多图训练转变为节点分类。
text.en: The unit of graph classification is an entire graph. HIV has one binary task; PCBA has 128. load_graph_classification_dataset reads a .pt file from the session upload directory with dataset_profile set to auto, hiv, or pcba, validates it, binds it to the session, and returns dataset_id. This collection is separate from the active single graph. load_graph_classification_graph can extract one sample for inspection without converting graph classification into node classification.

rows.zh: 非空 PyG Data 列表；每张图包含 x、xe、edge_index、y 张量，节点数必须大于零。
rows.en: A nonempty list of PyG Data objects; each graph contains x, xe, edge_index, and y tensors and at least one node.

rows.zh: 一维整型 [N]，存放节点类别编号；编号非负且在节点词表范围内。它不是节点的全局身份编号，也不是二维连续属性矩阵。
rows.en: An integer [N] vector of nonnegative node-category IDs within the node vocabulary. These are not global node identities or a two-dimensional continuous feature matrix.

rows.zh: xe 为一维整型 [E] 边类别编号；edge_index 为 [2, E] 整型索引且端点不越界。边类别必须由边词表覆盖。
rows.en: xe is an integer [E] vector of edge-category IDs; edge_index is an integer [2, E] tensor with valid endpoints. Categories must be covered by the edge vocabulary.

rows.zh: 每图 [T] 或 [1, T]，归一为 float32 [1, T]；允许 0、1、NaN，拒绝无穷值和其他标签值。全部图的 T 一致。
rows.en: Per-graph [T] or [1, T], normalized to float32 [1, T]; only 0, 1, and NaN are allowed, with infinities and other values rejected. T must be consistent across graphs.

rows.zh: 至少包含三个字符串列表，依次表示节点、边和标签文本；用于词表和描述，不会自动生成语言模型嵌入。
rows.en: At least three string lists for node, edge, and label text; these provide vocabularies and descriptions, not automatic language-model embeddings.

rows.zh: split[0] 包含 train、valid（或 val）、test 图索引列表；索引不重复、不重叠并覆盖全部图。split[1] 是 prompt/few-shot 元数据字典，只保留摘要，不改变训练采样。
rows.en: split[0] contains train, valid (or val), and test graph-index lists with no duplicates or overlap and complete graph coverage. split[1] is prompt/few-shot metadata whose summary is retained without changing training sampling.

text.zh: 图分类训练使用数据文件的固定划分，不能提交 train_config.split。它不接受 graph_version、method、upstream_model_id、data.target_nodes、data.target_edges 或嵌入模型特征来源。可显式传 data.dataset_id，也可使用当前绑定的数据集；其他任务不能使用这个字段。加载器计算完整文件 SHA-256 指纹，推理会据此验证数据身份，文件名相同并不代表数据相同。
text.en: Graph-classification training uses the file's fixed splits and rejects train_config.split. It does not accept graph_version, method, upstream_model_id, data.target_nodes, data.target_edges, or embedding feature input. Supply data.dataset_id explicitly or use the bound dataset; other tasks cannot use that field. The loader computes a full-file SHA-256 fingerprint that inference checks for dataset identity; an identical filename alone is insufficient.

title.zh: 模型结构、训练循环与评估

text.zh: GCN、GAT 与 SAGE 骨干网络由多层消息传递组成，常用配置为 hidden_dim=64、embedding_dim=64、num_layers=2、dropout=0.2。中间层使用 ReLU 与 dropout；GAT 默认 gat_heads=2，concat=False，以多头平均保持输出维度。use_residual_connection 可添加残差连接，维度不同时使用线性投影；use_normalization 控制归一化，norm_type 可选 rms_norm、layer_norm、batch_norm，norm_pos 可选 pre 或 post。
text.en: GCN, GAT, and SAGE consist of message-passing layers, commonly configured with hidden_dim=64, embedding_dim=64, num_layers=2, and dropout=0.2. Intermediate layers apply ReLU and dropout. GAT defaults to gat_heads=2 with concat=False, averaging heads to preserve output width. use_residual_connection adds residual connections with linear projections when dimensions differ. use_normalization enables rms_norm, layer_norm, or batch_norm, placed pre or post via norm_pos.

text.zh: 图分类先对节点类别做可训练的 nn.Embedding 编码，再经过 GNN、global_mean_pool 和线性图分类头。一个批次将多张图的节点与边拼接，用 batch 向量记录节点所属图：节点嵌入为 [ΣN, D]，池化结果为 [B, D]，最终 logits 为 [B, T]。train_config.batch_size 默认 64，num_workers 默认 0；训练批次打乱，验证与测试按固定顺序读取，不丢弃最后一个不足批大小的批次。
text.en: Graph classification begins with a trainable nn.Embedding of node categories, followed by the GNN, global_mean_pool, and a linear graph head. Batching concatenates nodes and edges and records graph membership in a batch vector: node embeddings are [ΣN, D], pooled features [B, D], and final logits [B, T]. train_config.batch_size defaults to 64 and num_workers to 0. Training batches shuffle; validation and test preserve order, and incomplete final batches are retained.

text.zh: 图分类采用带缺失标签掩码的 BCEWithLogitsLoss：仅在标签非 NaN 的位置取平均，一个批次全部缺失时跳过优化。训练集整轮没有有效标签会失败。HIV 用 ROC-AUC 选最佳模型；PCBA 对可评估任务分别计算 AP，再对这些任务取宏平均，同时记录有效与跳过的任务数。只有单一类别或全部缺失的任务无法贡献该指标，不能把 PCBA 指标表述为无条件平均全部 128 项。
text.en: Graph classification uses masked binary cross-entropy with logits, averaging only non-NaN labels. Batches with no observed labels skip optimization; an epoch with no valid training labels fails. HIV selects models by ROC-AUC. PCBA computes AP for each evaluable task and macro-averages those tasks, recording valid and skipped counts. Tasks with only one class or entirely missing labels do not contribute, so the result is not an unconditional mean over all 128 tasks.

text.zh: 三个监督任务使用 Adam。early_stop_patience=0 关闭早停，正整数表示连续多少轮没有改进后停止；early_stop_min_delta 默认 0，两个参数不能为负。图分类每轮只评估验证集，验证指标严格超过最佳值加 min_delta 才更新检查点；最终恢复最佳权重，再对测试集评估一次。预训练两个分支均没有这套验证选择和早停逻辑，不能把统一请求字段的存在理解为所有任务都执行它。
text.en: All three supervised tasks use Adam. early_stop_patience=0 disables early stopping; a positive integer sets consecutive non-improving epochs before stopping. early_stop_min_delta defaults to 0; neither value may be negative. Graph classification evaluates validation each epoch and updates the checkpoint only on strict improvement beyond min_delta. It restores the best weights and evaluates test once afterward. Neither pretraining branch implements this validation-selection and early-stopping flow.

rows.zh: 默认 200 / 0.05 / 0.0；示例显式设置学习率，数值不是调参结论。Node2Vec 使用 SparseAdam，忽略 weight_decay。
rows.en: Defaults are 200 / 0.05 / 0.0. Examples explicitly set the learning rate without claiming optimal tuning. Node2Vec uses SparseAdam and ignores weight_decay.

rows.zh: 默认 42，设置 Python、NumPy、PyTorch 与 CUDA 随机种子；多图 DataLoader 也使用种子与工作进程初始化。
rows.en: Defaults to 42 and seeds Python, NumPy, PyTorch, and CUDA. Multi-graph DataLoaders also use seeded generators and worker initialization.

rows.zh: cpu / cuda / auto；请求不可用的 CUDA 会失败。auto 无 GPU 时使用 CPU，多 GPU 时按空闲显存及可用利用率信息选择。Node2Vec 实际固定 CPU。
rows.en: cpu / cuda / auto; requesting unavailable CUDA fails. auto uses CPU without GPUs and chooses among GPUs using free memory and available utilization data. Node2Vec itself remains on CPU.

rows.zh: 训练逐轮报告损失与对应评估指标；监督任务报告 best_epoch、trained_epochs、stopped_early。检查这些字段以区分计划轮数、实际轮数和采用的权重。
rows.en: Training reports per-epoch loss and task metrics. Supervised tasks include best_epoch, trained_epochs, and stopped_early to distinguish scheduled epochs, actual epochs, and selected weights.

title.zh: 工具调用：提交训练与读取结果
title.en: Tool calls: submit training and retrieve results

text.zh: 以下 JSON 都是工具参数对象，在已验证身份并绑定会话的 MCP / 智能体工具环境中使用。参数示例展示数据结构，不包含测得的性能或最佳超参数。单图训练前先加载具备相应标签或结构的数据；分子图分类则先上传数据文件并执行数据集加载工具。示例中的文件名、dataset_id、model_id 与节点名应替换为实际返回值和真实数据名称。
text.en: The JSON below contains tool argument objects for an authenticated, session-bound MCP or agent tool environment. These examples demonstrate request structure, not measured performance or optimal hyperparameters. Load a suitable labeled or structured single graph before single-graph training; for molecular classification, upload and load the dataset first. Replace filenames, dataset_id, model_id, and node names with actual results and data names.

text.zh: 节点分类：调用 train，使用活动图特征，按验证准确率选择模型。对于没有 train_mask 的图，split 控制本次随机划分。
text.en: Node classification: call train with active-graph features and validation-accuracy model selection. split controls the run's random partition when train_mask is absent.

text.zh: 链接预测：调用 train，使用图中的逻辑边作为正样本。需要限定监督正边时可提供 data.target_edges，其元素是两个节点名组成的数组。
text.en: Link prediction: call train with logical graph edges as positives. To restrict supervised positives, provide data.target_edges as arrays of two node names.

text.zh: Node2Vec：调用 train，显式给出嵌入维度、随机游走配置和该分支的批大小。
text.en: Node2Vec: call train with an explicit embedding dimension, random-walk settings, and this branch's batch size.

text.zh: 分子图分类：先调用 load_graph_classification_dataset；加载完成后把返回的 dataset_id 填入第二个对象，并用它调用 train。
text.en: Molecular graph classification: first call load_graph_classification_dataset. After loading completes, insert its dataset_id into the second object and call train.

text.zh: 直接使用 MCP 时，长任务可能先返回 job_id。用 get_job_status 查询作业；首次传 after_seq=0，后续将返回的 progress_cursor 作为 after_seq 增量读取进度；progress_has_more=true 时继续翻页。完成状态为 job.status=done，训练结果位于 job.result；确认结果 success=true 后读取 model_id，再提交 infer。智能体的 GraphMCPTools 包装会自动等待并解析这些作业，通常直接交付最终结果。
text.en: Direct MCP calls may initially return job_id for long-running work. Poll get_job_status; start with after_seq=0, then pass the returned progress_cursor as after_seq for incremental progress, continuing while progress_has_more=true. Completion is job.status=done, with the training result under job.result. Confirm result success=true, read model_id, then call infer. The agent's GraphMCPTools wrapper automatically waits for and resolves these jobs, normally delivering the final result.

text.zh: infer 根据模型元数据选择任务分支。节点分类与链接预测重新构造骨干网络、加载训练检查点，在当前图上执行前向传播；图分类重新加载模型对应的数据集并检查身份；预训练返回保存的节点向量。返回的 model_id、task 与图版本或数据集标识可用于确认结果来自哪个模型和输入。
text.en: infer dispatches using saved task metadata. Node classification and link prediction rebuild the backbone, load its checkpoint, and run on the current graph. Graph classification resolves and verifies its dataset. Pretraining returns stored node vectors. The returned model_id, task, and graph-version or dataset identifier identify the model and input behind the result.

text.zh: 节点分类按节点名查询：predictions 包含 pred_class_idx、pred_label 等类别信息，标签可用时还返回真实标签及正确性；开启 return_prob 可取各类别概率。result_limit 与 result_offset 仅分页明细，评估基于请求的完整节点集合。空 query 返回划分评估摘要和抽样预测；query.split 仅能选择图中实际存在的掩码。
text.en: For node-name queries, predictions contain class information such as pred_class_idx and pred_label, plus true labels and correctness when available. Enable return_prob for class probabilities. result_limit and result_offset paginate details while evaluation covers all requested nodes. An empty query returns split evaluation summaries and sampled predictions; query.split requires an actual graph mask.

text.zh: 链接预测可指定 query.edges，也可给出 source_node 与 candidate_nodes 做候选排序。每条结果包含 score、prob、pred 与 exists_in_graph；判定使用模型保存的验证阈值。候选列表可以包含已有边，调用方可根据 exists_in_graph 筛选。空 query 会搜索非边候选，虽然 max_candidate_pairs 限制保留和评分的候选量，生成阶段仍遍历节点对，大图上优先提供明确候选范围。
text.en: Link prediction accepts query.edges or source_node with candidate_nodes for ranking. Each prediction contains score, prob, pred, and exists_in_graph, using the saved validation threshold. Candidates may include existing edges, which callers can filter by exists_in_graph. An empty query searches nonedges: max_candidate_pairs bounds retained/scored candidates, but generation still iterates over node pairs. Prefer explicit candidates for large graphs.

text.zh: 图分类 query.split 可选 train、val、test，空 query 默认 test；也可用 graph_indices 指定图索引，二者不能同时出现。HIV 明细含 probability、predicted_label 和 true_label；PCBA 默认返回概率最高的 5 个任务，可用 top_k_tasks 调整，return_all_task_probs=true 返回完整任务概率。evaluation 对完整请求集合计算，count 为请求图数，returned_count 为本页数量，truncated 表示仍有明细未显示。
text.en: Graph classification accepts query.split=train, val, or test, defaulting to test for an empty query, or explicit graph_indices; these options are mutually exclusive. HIV details include probability, predicted_label, and true_label. PCBA defaults to the five highest-probability tasks, configurable with top_k_tasks; return_all_task_probs=true includes complete task probabilities. evaluation covers the full query, count is the requested graph count, returned_count is the page size, and truncated indicates omitted details.

text.zh: 图分类推理接受 infer_config.device；节点分类与链接预测的推理路径当前自动选择设备，不能假定相同字段对它们具有相同作用。对于预训练模型，下面的调用只读取已有节点向量，返回 embeddings 数组，每项包含 node 与嵌入模型。
text.en: Graph-classification inference accepts infer_config.device. Node-classification and link-prediction inference currently select a device automatically, so the same field should not be assumed to control them. For a pretrained model, the following call only reads saved node vectors, returning an embeddings array of node and embedding entries.

title.zh: 模型文件、版本绑定与复现
title.en: Model files, version binding, and reproducibility

text.zh: 训练产物存放在 Graph Engine 的模型目录中，默认根目录为 artifacts/graph_ml，可通过 GRAPH_ML_ARTIFACT_ROOT 配置。模型目录按运行时的用户与会话作用域隔离，model_id 指向具体一次训练产物。图机器学习模块按需初始化；受控工作进程执行训练时先写入暂存目录，Graph Engine 验证作业仍有效后发布模型文件。收到 job_id 本身不等于模型已经可用。
text.en: Training outputs live in Graph Engine's model directory, defaulting to artifacts/graph_ml and configurable with GRAPH_ML_ARTIFACT_ROOT. Directories are isolated by runtime user/session scope, and model_id identifies one training output. Graph ML initializes lazily. Controlled workers write staging outputs, which Graph Engine publishes after validating that the job remains eligible. Receiving job_id does not mean the model is already available.

headers.zh: 模型目录中的主要文件
headers.en: Main files in a model directory

rows.zh: checkpoint.pt：backbone 与 head；meta.json：模型结构、特征来源、类别映射、graph_version；metrics.json 与 node_names.json。
rows.en: checkpoint.pt: backbone and head; meta.json: architecture, feature source, label mapping, and graph_version; metrics.json and node_names.json.

rows.zh: checkpoint.pt：backbone；meta.json 另记录 threshold；metrics.json 与 node_names.json。
rows.en: checkpoint.pt: backbone; meta.json also records threshold; metrics.json and node_names.json.
embedding.npy, node_names.json, meta.json, and metrics.json; no checkpoint.pt.
checkpoint.pt: backbone; plus embedding.npy, node_names.json, meta.json, and metrics.json.

rows.zh: checkpoint.pt：model 权重；meta.json：数据集指纹、词表大小、任务数、模型配置与划分大小；metrics.json、per_task_metrics.json。
rows.en: checkpoint.pt: model weights; meta.json: dataset fingerprint, vocabulary sizes, task count, model configuration, and split sizes; metrics.json and per_task_metrics.json.

text.zh: 单图 train 的 graph_version 是对当前活动版本的校验，并不会自动加载历史图。需要旧版本时先调用 load_graph_version，再训练。节点分类与链接预测推理默认要求当前图版本等于训练版本；infer_config.allow_version_mismatch=true 可跳过这项版本限制，但不会解决输入维度、标签语义或上游嵌入不兼容。预训练向量查询校验的是已保存模型版本，不依赖当前活动图；图分类则绑定 dataset_id 与完整数据集指纹。
text.en: Single-graph train treats graph_version as an assertion about the active version, not a request to load history. Call load_graph_version first to train on an older version. Node-classification and link-prediction inference require the active version to match training by default. infer_config.allow_version_mismatch=true skips this version check but cannot resolve incompatible input dimensions, label semantics, or upstream embeddings. Pretrained-vector lookup checks saved model version without relying on the active graph; graph classification binds dataset_id and the full dataset fingerprint.

text.zh: 复现实验时应另行保存完整 train 请求、源数据文件及指纹、图版本、上游 model_id、依赖版本和实际设备。现有元数据记录模型结构及结果，但没有完整保存所有训练超参数、随机数状态和优化器状态，也没有公开的断点续训接口。seed 控制主要随机源，却没有开启强制确定性算法；GPU 内核和软件环境变化仍可能造成结果差异，因此不能仅凭相同 seed 保证逐位一致。
text.en: For reproducible experiments, separately preserve the complete train request, source data and fingerprint, graph version, upstream model_id, dependency versions, and actual device. Metadata records architecture and results but does not preserve every training hyperparameter, RNG state, or optimizer state, and there is no public resume-training endpoint. seed controls major random sources but deterministic algorithms are not enforced; GPU kernels and environment changes can still affect results, so matching seed alone does not guarantee bitwise reproducibility.

text.zh: visualize_model_architecture 接收 model_id，读取保存的模型配置用于检查结构。结构图描述网络层与计算路径，不代替任务指标。比较实验时同时查看最佳轮次、实际训练轮数、数据划分协议、验证与测试样本是否独立，以及 PCBA 有效任务数量。
text.en: visualize_model_architecture accepts model_id and reads saved model configuration for architecture inspection. The visualization explains layers and computation, not predictive quality. When comparing runs, inspect best epoch, actual epochs, split protocol, validation/test independence, and PCBA's evaluable-task count alongside metrics.

items.zh: 图分类使用节点类别嵌入、GCN / GAT / SAGE、固定全局均值池化和图级线性头。xe 已读取、校验和保留，但不进入前向传播；模型元数据明确记录 uses_edge_features=false。不能据此宣称模型利用了分子键类型。
items.en: Graph classification uses node-category embeddings, GCN / GAT / SAGE, fixed global mean pooling, and a linear graph head. xe is read, validated, and retained but never enters the forward pass; metadata explicitly records uses_edge_features=false. This model cannot be described as using molecular bond types.

items.zh: 没有注册 GIN、GINE 或可切换图池化；HIV / PCBA 加载路径也不等价于任意 OGB 数据集支持。多图任务要求约定的 .pt 数据结构与固定划分，不能在 train 中任意指定新指标或重划测试集。
items.en: GIN, GINE, and configurable graph pooling are not registered. The HIV / PCBA loading path does not imply arbitrary OGB support. Multi-graph tasks require the defined .pt structure and fixed splits; train does not accept arbitrary metrics or a replacement test split.

items.zh: 单图监督任务和 GNN 预训练使用整图前向传播，没有邻居采样小批训练。train_config.batch_size 不会降低这些路径的整图特征和中间激活显存需求；它用于图分类，Node2Vec 则使用自己的批大小字段。
items.en: Single-graph supervised tasks and GNN pretraining use full-graph forward passes without neighbor-sampled minibatches. train_config.batch_size does not reduce their full-graph feature or activation memory; it applies to graph classification, while Node2Vec has its own batch-size field.

items.zh: 二维节点标签经 argmax 进入单标签分类；分子图分类的 [B, T] 独立二分类才具有多任务标签语义。不要把两者的数据形状相似理解为同一种训练目标。
items.en: Two-dimensional node labels enter single-label classification through argmax. Molecular graph classification instead uses [B, T] independent binary tasks. Similar tensor shapes do not imply the same learning objective.

items.zh: 链接预测验证边仍参与消息传递，内积解码不区分方向；GNN 预训练方法名当前共享边重构实现。这些实现边界需要与指标一起说明，才能正确比较模型与研究基线。
items.en: Link-prediction validation edges remain in message passing and its dot-product decoder is direction-invariant. Named GNN pretraining methods share edge reconstruction. Describe these boundaries alongside metrics for meaningful comparison with research baselines.

items.zh: 当前接口没有提供自动超参数搜索、类别加权损失、学习率调度器、优化器状态恢复或跨环境确定性保证。本页示例是可理解的调用配置，不包含尚未执行的性能测试结论。
items.en: The current interface provides no automatic hyperparameter search, class-weighted loss, learning-rate scheduler, optimizer-state restoration, or cross-environment determinism guarantee. The examples explain request configurations and do not claim unperformed performance measurements.

description.zh: 面向客户端的 Backend HTTP 接口：身份、会话、数据集与构图。
description.en: Backend HTTP interfaces for client integrations: identity, sessions, datasets, and construction. Examples target your running service; this site does not execute API calls.

text.zh: 本指南默认使用 Compose 的公共入口 http://localhost:21108；单独运行 Backend 时，可改为 http://localhost:21109。所有业务 API 使用 /api 前缀。JSON 请求带 Content-Type: application/json；上传使用 multipart/form-data。运行服务的 /openapi.json 提供完整机器可读定义，/docs 打开 Swagger。
text.en: Examples use the Compose public entry point http://localhost:21108. When running Backend separately, use http://localhost:21109 instead. Business APIs use /api. Send Content-Type: application/json for JSON and multipart/form-data for uploads. The running service serves its complete schema at /openapi.json and Swagger at /docs.

text.zh: 请求头 X-User-ID 为已启用用户的 ID；不需要请求体。有效身份返回用户和模型权限信息，无效身份返回 valid: false。其他业务接口缺少、无效或禁用的用户返回 401。管理员接口额外检查 admin 角色，缺失时返回 403。
text.en: Set X-User-ID to an enabled user ID. No body is required. Valid identities return user and model information; invalid identities return valid: false. Other business endpoints return 401 for missing, invalid, or disabled users. Admin endpoints also require the admin role and return 403 otherwise.

text.zh: 当前契约是用户目录校验，不是密码认证或 JWT/OAuth。部署真实 Backend 时应在可信身份网关后提供此接口；不要把用户 ID 当成秘密令牌。
text.en: The current contract validates a user directory; it is not password authentication or JWT/OAuth. Place a real Backend behind a trusted identity gateway. Do not treat user IDs as secret tokens. This does not affect the public read-only documentation site.

rows.zh: 可选客户端幂等 UUID，最长 64 字符；非 UUID 返回 400。
rows.en: Optional client idempotency UUID, up to 64 characters; invalid UUIDs return 400.

rows.zh: 可选模型 ID；服务端校验用户权限。
rows.en: Optional model ID, checked against user permissions.

rows.zh: 项目归属；null 为非项目会话。
rows.en: Project ownership; null for a non-project session.

rows.zh: 可选当前数据集；必须具有访问权限。
rows.en: Optional active dataset; access is required.

rows.zh: 最长 1000 字符；作为会话标题等元信息。
rows.en: Up to 1,000 characters, used for session metadata such as title.

text.zh: 成功响应包含 success、session_id，以及当前 model、project_id、active_dataset_id 等信息。复用客户端 ID 时可能返回 reused: true。创建会话后调用 chat/stream 发送消息。
text.en: Successful responses include success, session_id, and information such as model, project_id, and active_dataset_id. Reusing a client ID may return reused: true. Send a message using chat/stream after creation.

rows.en: List sessions for the current user

rows.zh: 恢复消息、活动 Run、待审批项与数据集视图
rows.en: Restore messages, active run, pending feedback, and dataset view
Submit a message and receive SSE

rows.zh: 从事件游标续接；无请求体
rows.en: Resume from a cursor; no request body

rows.zh: 请求取消；需要能力开关
rows.en: Request cancellation; requires the capability flag

rows.zh: 删除会话；202 表示已接受持久化停止/删除
rows.en: Delete a session; 202 acknowledges durable stop/delete work

rows.zh: 可选显示名称，默认空字符串。
rows.en: Optional display name; defaults to an empty string.

rows.zh: 可选会话 ID，默认空字符串。
rows.en: Optional session ID; defaults to an empty string.

text.zh: 响应包含 success、dataset、default_dataset_id、activated_session_id、dataset_view 和 construction_required。使用 dataset.dataset_id 发起构图；construction_required 为 true 时，先完成构图再用于单图分析。
text.en: The response includes success, dataset, default_dataset_id, activated_session_id, dataset_view, and construction_required. Use dataset.dataset_id for construction. If construction_required is true, build the graph before single-graph analysis.

rows.zh: 检查 X-User-ID 和服务端用户目录
rows.en: Check X-User-ID and the server user directory

rows.zh: 使用被授权的用户、角色和模型
rows.en: Use an authorized user, role, and model

rows.zh: 资源不存在或不可访问
核对资源 ID 和所属用户/项目
状态或图 revision 冲突
重新读取状态后再操作，勿盲目重试写入
rows.en: Read current state before retrying a write

rows.zh: 检查响应 detail 与字段类型
本次未启动，退避后重试。
rows.en: No build was started; back off before retrying.
Construction still running or unconfirmed: construction_running_unconfirmed

rows.zh: 先读取构图状态，避免超时后立即重复构图。
rows.en: Read construction state first; do not immediately submit a duplicate build after a timeout.

text.zh: FastAPI 的 detail 可能是字符串、结构化对象或验证错误数组，不应假定统一错误 envelope。流建立后的失败需结合 SSE 终止事件、快照与 control 状态处理。
text.en: FastAPI detail can be a string, a structured object, or a validation-error array. Do not assume one universal error envelope. After a stream starts, combine terminal events, snapshots, and control state to handle failures.

text.zh: 未注册的 TXT 构图算法可能返回 HTTP 200，同时 success: false、status: algorithm_unavailable。HTTP 成功不能替代构图业务状态检查。
text.en: An unregistered TXT builder can return HTTP 200 with success: false and status: algorithm_unavailable. HTTP success does not imply construction succeeded.

description.zh: 把会话与 Run 分开处理，通过事件游标恢复连接，并区分断开连接、取消请求和执行结束。
description.en: Treat sessions and runs separately, resume with event cursors, and distinguish disconnection from cancellation and confirmed completion.

text.zh: 客户端向聊天、反馈和 resume 请求发送 X-iGraph-Stream-Version: 2。浏览器使用 fetch 流读取器；原生 EventSource 无法直接发送这些 POST 请求及自定义身份头。服务端返回 text/event-stream。
text.en: Send X-iGraph-Stream-Version: 2 on chat, feedback, and resume requests. Browser clients use fetch streaming; native EventSource cannot directly send these POST requests with custom identity headers. The response content type is text/event-stream.

rows.zh: 为每个新请求生成 UUID；重试同一请求时保留。
rows.en: Generate a UUID for a new request; retain it when retrying that same request.

rows.zh: 附件引用包含 file_token 和可选 filename。
rows.en: Attachment references contain file_token and optional filename.

text.zh: Backend 使用原生后台流式 Run。stream/background 是前端发送的兼容字段；ChatReq 的核心契约以上述字段和 reasoning_mode / planning_mode 等模型字段为准。
text.en: Backend uses native background streaming runs. The frontend sends stream/background as compatibility fields; the core ChatReq contract uses the fields above plus model fields such as reasoning_mode and planning_mode.

items.zh: 同页面断流：保留已有消息，从最后完整应用的 event_index 续接。消息、工具、计划与游标应在同一状态事务提交。
items.en: Same-page disconnect: keep existing messages and resume from the last fully applied event_index. Commit messages, tools, plans, and the cursor in one state transaction.

items.zh: 刷新或消息内存丢失：从 last_event_index=-1 暂存重建当前 Run，追平后发布，保留其他历史消息。
items.en: After a refresh or loss of message state: rebuild the current run into temporary state from last_event_index=-1, publish after catching up, and retain other historical messages.

items.zh: HTTP 409 REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE 或 stream_recovery_required：保留内容，轮询 snapshot，直到 snapshot_complete=true 后原子替换阶段消息。
items.en: On HTTP 409 REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE or stream_recovery_required: preserve content and poll snapshot, replacing phase messages atomically only once snapshot_complete=true.

items.zh: 快照 resume_cursor 当前为 null，不能将快照消息与旧游标后的原始增量拼接。使用快照恢复暂停阶段后，该 Run 保持快照模式。
items.en: Snapshots currently return resume_cursor=null. Do not combine snapshot messages with raw deltas after an old cursor. A run restored from a paused-phase snapshot stays in snapshot mode.

text.zh: 恢复只读取已有 Run，不自动重发问题或审批。它依赖 Agent Runtime 进程仍存活、网络恢复及结果可读；不提供进程重启后的任务续跑。
text.en: Recovery reads an existing run without automatically resubmitting messages or decisions. It depends on a live Agent Runtime process, restored connectivity, and readable results; it does not resume task execution after a process restart.

text.zh: 先调用 GET /api/capabilities，run_cancel_v1 启用时才展示停止操作。取消请求携带 target.run_id 或 target.start_request_id 二选一，再提供 cancel_request_id；这些字段都必须是合法 UUID。同一次取消重试保持相同 cancel_request_id。
text.en: Call GET /api/capabilities and expose cancellation only when run_cancel_v1 is enabled. Send exactly one of target.run_id and target.start_request_id, plus cancel_request_id; each must be a valid UUID. Retain cancel_request_id when retrying the same cancellation.

text.zh: 取消后查询 GET /api/sessions/{sid}/runs/control?run_id={rid}。execution_stopped 表示执行已停止，terminal_persisted 表示最终状态已保存；只有两者都满足且服务端允许发送时才恢复编辑。AbortController 只断开观察连接，不等于取消服务器任务。
text.en: After cancelling, query GET /api/sessions/{sid}/runs/control?run_id={rid}. execution_stopped reports stopped execution; terminal_persisted reports a saved terminal state. Resume editing only when both hold and the server permits sending. AbortController disconnects the observer; it does not cancel server execution.

text.zh: 取消接口返回 200 只说明 execution_stopped 已为 true；未停止时返回 202。仍需同时确认 terminal_persisted 和 can_send，才能认定客户端已可以继续。
text.en: HTTP 200 from cancellation indicates execution_stopped is true; otherwise the endpoint returns 202. Still check terminal_persisted and can_send before allowing the client to continue.

text.zh: 审批使用 run_id、request_id、decision_id 与 decision（approve / modify / reject）；可携带 patched_args、comment、tool_call_id 和 tool_name。前端在等待审批或提交审批时阻止新聊天，确认接收与运行状态后再继续。
text.en: Feedback uses run_id, request_id, decision_id, and decision (approve / modify / reject), with optional patched_args, comment, tool_call_id, and tool_name. The frontend blocks new chat while awaiting or submitting feedback, then resumes after reconciling acceptance and run state.

description.zh: 区分项目运行时配置与文档站构建配置，保持凭据、服务地址和资源预算的作用域清晰。
description.en: Separate project runtime configuration from documentation build settings and keep credentials, service URLs, and resource budgets scoped correctly.

rows.zh: 四个服务共享；非空、无空白 ASCII
rows.en: Shared by four services; non-empty ASCII without whitespace

rows.zh: 所有服务验收完成后统一启用
rows.en: Enable consistently after validating every service
rules is an explicit offline baseline

rows.zh: 同用户领域策略经验，当前数据仍须重新验收
rows.en: Per-user domain experience; current data must still be revalidated

rows.zh: 每用户训练/推理等重任务上限
rows.en: Heavy-task limit per user, including training/inference

text.zh: 独立文档站没有模型 Key、数据库连接或 Backend 地址。wrangler.jsonc 只指定站点名称、兼容日期和 dist 静态资产目录。可选 SITE_URL 在构建时生成绝对 canonical 和 sitemap；值应为实际部署后的 HTTPS 域名。
text.en: The independent docs site has no model keys, database connections, or Backend URL. wrangler.jsonc declares only the site name, compatibility date, and dist asset directory. Optional SITE_URL adds absolute canonical URLs and a sitemap at build time; set it to your actual deployed HTTPS origin.

text.zh: 只发布 docs-site/dist。项目根目录的 .env、源数据、模型、用户目录以及原工作台都不会被打包进文档站。
text.en: Only docs-site/dist is published. The project .env, source datasets, models, user directories, and original workspace are not packaged into this site.

description.zh: 按智能体、图算法、构图和图学习整理 24 个核心术语，说明各术语的含义及在 iGraph 中的具体用途。
description.en: Definitions and iGraph-specific usage for 24 core terms across agents, graph algorithms, construction, and graph learning.

rows.zh: 结合模型推理、任务状态与工具调用来完成目标的软件执行主体。
rows.en: A software actor that combines model reasoning, task state, and tool calls to pursue a goal.

rows.zh: iGraph 是图驱动的数据分析智能体：从用户问题选择证据操作，读取图查询、算法与学习结果，再组织后续分析和解释。具体图运算由 Graph Engine 执行。
rows.en: iGraph is a graph-driven data analysis agent: it selects evidence-producing operations from user questions, reads graph queries, algorithm and learning results, and organizes further analysis and interpretation. Graph Engine performs the computation.

rows.zh: 围绕一类任务组织的可复用说明、流程与辅助资源，使智能体能够按需采用相应方法。
rows.en: Reusable instructions, workflows, and supporting resources organized around a task family for an agent to apply when needed.

rows.zh: 技能指导图分析和构图流程。构图智能体结合领域经验选择结构变换，在固定查询上验收候选方案，并将可复用经验用于后续策略选择。技能不是某个图算法函数的别名。
rows.en: Skills guide analysis and construction workflows. The construction agent uses domain experience to choose transformations, validates candidates on fixed queries, and reuses learned experience in later strategy selection. A skill is not simply an alias for an algorithm function.

rows.zh: 按照工具声明的名称和参数数据结构，请求一个明确操作并接收结构化结果。
rows.en: A request for a defined operation using its declared name and parameter structure, followed by a structured result.

rows.zh: 例如 shortest_path 接收 source、target 等参数。智能体通过 MCP 调用 Graph Engine；工具返回的 success、结果字段和错误决定下一步操作。
rows.en: For example, shortest_path accepts source and target. The agent calls Graph Engine through MCP, using success, result fields, and errors to determine the next step.

rows.zh: 组织一段交互及其关联状态的隔离作用域。
rows.en: An isolated scope for an interaction and its associated state.

rows.zh: iGraph 在用户身份下按 session_id 管理活动图、上传文件、模型和作业等状态。切换会话不等于切换同一会话内的 graph_version；模型也需要在对应会话作用域内解析。
rows.en: Within a user identity, session_id scopes the active graph, uploads, models, and jobs. Switching sessions differs from switching graph_version within one session; models must also resolve in their corresponding session scope.

rows.zh: 提交后独立运行，并通过标识查询状态、进度和最终结果的执行单元。
rows.en: An execution unit that continues after submission and exposes status, progress, and a final result through an identifier.

rows.zh: 训练等长任务可能返回 job_id；get_job_status 查询该作业，完成结果位于 job.result。请求取消与确认计算已经停止是不同阶段。
rows.en: Long tasks such as training may return job_id. get_job_status queries the job and exposes the completed result under job.result. Requesting cancellation and confirming that computation has stopped are distinct stages.

rows.zh: 服务器通过持续的 HTTP 响应向客户端单向发送事件的流式传输机制。
rows.en: A streaming mechanism in which a server sends events to a client over a persistent HTTP response.

rows.zh: iGraph 用事件流向界面传递运行消息与进度。事件到达、连接断开和作业最终状态分别表示不同事实；界面应依据明确的状态字段判断完成。
rows.en: iGraph streams runtime messages and progress to the interface. Event arrival, connection closure, and a terminal job state are distinct facts; the interface should use explicit state fields to determine completion.

rows.zh: 同一对端点之间存在的多条独立关系；每条关系可有不同标识、类型或属性。
rows.en: Multiple distinct relationships between the same endpoint pair, potentially with different identities, types, or attributes.

rows.zh: GraphData 可保留逻辑边标识。部分算法需要临时投影视图，例如最短路径按端点对取最小权重；这种计算投影不应被理解为源关系被删除或合并保存。
rows.en: GraphData preserves logical edge identity. Some algorithms require a temporary projection, such as the minimum weight per endpoint pair for shortest paths. This calculation view does not delete or permanently merge source relationships.

rows.zh: 在给定方向与成本定义下，从起点到终点使总成本最小的路径；无权时成本通常是边数。
rows.en: A path minimizing total cost from source to target under the chosen direction and cost model; unweighted cost is usually the edge count.

rows.zh: shortest_path 的 use_weight=true 将权重解释为距离或成本，false 则按跳数计算。边权表示相似度时，需要先明确它是否适合直接作为路径距离。
rows.en: shortest_path interprets weights as distances or costs when use_weight=true, and minimizes hops when false. If weights represent similarity, first establish whether they are suitable as direct path distances.

rows.zh: 根据连接结构识别内部连接较密集、群体之间连接相对稀疏的节点集合。
rows.en: Identifying node groups that are relatively densely connected internally and more sparsely connected to other groups.

rows.zh: community_detection 可选择 Louvain 等方法，返回社区规模、节点预览和模块度。这里的社区是结构分组，不自动具有业务类别标签；结果也取决于方向、权重和算法选项。
rows.en: community_detection supports methods such as Louvain and returns community sizes, node previews, and modularity. Communities are structural groups rather than automatic business labels, and results depend on direction, weights, and algorithm choices.

rows.zh: 统计节点位于其他节点对最短路径上的份额，用于描述其在最短路径结构中的中介作用。
rows.en: The share of shortest paths between other node pairs that pass through a node, describing its intermediary role in shortest-path structure.

rows.zh: node_centrality 选择 centrality_type=betweenness 时计算此指标，可用于寻找连接群体的桥接节点。高介数是特定图和路径定义下的结构特征，不能直接等同于真实业务影响力。
rows.en: Select centrality_type=betweenness in node_centrality to identify potential bridging nodes. High betweenness is a structural property under a particular graph and path definition, not direct evidence of real-world business influence.

rows.zh: 根据节点与其他可达节点的最短路径距离衡量其接近程度；常见形式与平均距离的倒数有关。
rows.en: A measure of proximity based on shortest-path distances to reachable nodes, commonly related to the reciprocal of mean distance.

rows.zh: node_centrality 选择 centrality_type=closeness。解释数值时要考虑图是否连通、是否有向及距离语义，不能只比较连接数，也不能将不可达节点当作零距离。
rows.en: Select centrality_type=closeness in node_centrality. Interpret values using connectivity, direction, and distance semantics; the metric is not just degree, and unreachable nodes must not be treated as zero-distance nodes.

rows.zh: 在无向简单图语义下，衡量相邻两步关系闭合为三角形的比例，等于三角形数的三倍除以连通三元组数。
rows.en: Under undirected simple-graph semantics, the proportion of connected two-step triples closed into triangles: three times the triangle count divided by the number of connected triples.

rows.zh: global_metrics 的 metric=transitivity 在无向计算视图上计算该值。它与先逐节点计算局部聚类系数再取平均的 average_clustering 是不同指标。
rows.en: global_metrics with metric=transitivity computes this value on an undirected calculation view. It differs from average_clustering, which averages local clustering coefficients across nodes.

rows.zh: 标识某个会话中可保存、加载和分析的图状态。
rows.en: An identifier for a graph state that can be saved, loaded, and analyzed within a session.

rows.zh: get_graph_info 返回活动 graph_version，load_graph_version 可切换已保存版本。图学习用它校验输入一致性；构图数据集的 revision 和执行控制的 generation 不属于这套图版本编号。
rows.en: get_graph_info returns the active graph_version, and load_graph_version selects a saved one. Graph ML uses it to check input consistency. Dataset construction revision and execution generation are separate identifiers.

rows.zh: 保存的构图结果在编辑与提交过程中使用的修订编号。
rows.en: A revision number for a constructed dataset document as it is edited and committed.

rows.zh: 构图编辑请求携带 base_revision，服务端检查它与当前 revision 是否一致，防止旧编辑覆盖新内容。load_constructed_graph 才将构图结果装入会话图；修订号不应直接充当 graph_version。
rows.en: Construction edits carry base_revision, checked against the current revision to prevent stale edits overwriting newer content. load_constructed_graph loads the constructed result into the session graph; revision must not be substituted for graph_version.

rows.zh: 用于区分一次运行当前有效执行与过期执行的控制标识。
rows.en: A control identifier distinguishing the current valid execution of a run from stale executions.

rows.zh: Run、Job 和工作进程回执携带 generation。执行控制在继续运行和状态发布时校验代次，阻止过期结果进入当前状态。它描述执行有效性，不描述图内容是否发生变化。
rows.en: Run, job, and worker receipts carry generation. Execution control validates generations when continuing work and publishing state to reject stale results. It describes execution validity rather than changes to graph content.

rows.zh: 在独立参考数据上执行查询、产生用于核对的参考答案的执行器。
rows.en: An executor that evaluates queries against independent reference data to produce comparison answers.

rows.zh: 构图验收把固定查询计划编译为 SQL，在源表上生成期望结果，再与只读取候选图的 GraphExecutor 比较。这里的 oracle 是语义校验角色，不表示使用 Oracle 数据库，也不是模型自行编写的答案。
rows.en: Construction validation compiles fixed query plans to SQL against source tables, then compares those answers with GraphExecutor reading only the candidate graph. oracle denotes the validation role, not the Oracle database or model-authored answers.

rows.zh: 转换后的表示完整保留源记录标识、字段值及声明关系等语义的性质。
rows.en: The preservation of source-record identity, field values, and declared relationship semantics in a transformed representation.

rows.zh: source_integrity_errors 检查全部源记录与声明外键，覆盖固定查询没有访问的数据。查询全部通过与源数据完整性通过是两项检查，不能用其中一项替代另一项。
rows.en: source_integrity_errors checks every source record and declared foreign key, including data untouched by the fixed queries. Passing all queries and passing integrity checks are separate requirements.

rows.zh: 在比较候选方案之前确定、并在比较期间保持不变的一组查询与执行计划。
rows.en: A set of queries and execution plans fixed before candidate comparison and kept unchanged throughout that comparison.

rows.zh: 构图智能体通过 set_workload 提交查询，随后在同一工作负载上比较语义正确性与执行成本。冻结查询防止通过改题提高得分；通过率只覆盖这组查询，不代表任意问题的正确率。
rows.en: The construction agent submits queries with set_workload, then compares semantic correctness and execution cost on that same workload. Freezing prevents score improvement by changing the questions; pass rate applies to this set, not arbitrary questions.

rows.zh: 图神经网络沿边收集邻居信息，并通过聚合和变换更新节点表示的计算过程。
rows.en: A graph-neural-network computation that collects information along edges, aggregates it, and transforms node representations.

rows.zh: GCN、GAT 与 SAGE 以 x 和 edge_index 计算节点嵌入。当前这些骨干网络没有接收边权或 xe 作为消息特征；‘沿边计算’不等于‘使用全部边属性’。
rows.en: GCN, GAT, and SAGE compute node embeddings from x and edge_index. These backbones currently receive neither edge weights nor xe as message features; operating along edges does not mean using every edge attribute.

rows.zh: 将同一张图的节点或边表示聚合为一个固定维度图表示的操作。
rows.en: An operation that aggregates representations of nodes or edges within a graph into a fixed-dimensional graph representation.

rows.zh: 图分类采用 global_mean_pool，对每张图的节点嵌入求均值，形成 [B, D] 批次表示，再送入图级线性分类头。当前接口没有提供切换求和或最大值读出的选项。
rows.en: Graph classification uses global_mean_pool to average each graph's node embeddings into a [B, D] batch representation before a graph-level linear head. The current interface does not expose a switch to sum or maximum readout.

rows.zh: 以固定维度数值向量表示节点或图等对象，使其可参与数值预测和相似性计算。
rows.en: A fixed-dimensional numerical representation of an object such as a node or graph for prediction and similarity computation.

rows.zh: 预训练保存节点 embedding.npy 与对应名称；data.feature_source=embedding 按名称复用这些向量。复用嵌入不等于恢复上游模型的训练检查点，未知节点名当前填零向量。
rows.en: Pretraining saves node embedding.npy and corresponding names. data.feature_source=embedding reuses these vectors by name. Reusing embeddings does not restore an upstream training checkpoint; unmatched node names currently receive zero vectors.

rows.zh: 以单个节点为预测对象，为其确定类别标签的监督学习任务。
rows.en: A supervised task that assigns a class label to each target node.

rows.zh: task=node_classification 在活动图上运行 GNN 和分类头，用已标注训练节点计算交叉熵。二维节点标签当前先取 argmax，仍是单标签分类；不能据此宣称支持多标签节点分类。
rows.en: task=node_classification runs a GNN and classification head on the active graph, applying cross-entropy to labeled training nodes. Two-dimensional node labels are reduced with argmax, so this remains single-label rather than multi-label node classification.

rows.zh: 以节点对为预测对象，估计其连接可能性或相关分数的任务。
rows.en: A task that scores node pairs for their likelihood of being connected.

rows.zh: task=link_prediction 使用节点嵌入内积解码，返回分数和 sigmoid 概率。该解码对称，且当前验证边仍参与消息传递；解释指标时需要说明这两项实现条件。
rows.en: task=link_prediction uses an embedding dot-product decoder and returns scores and sigmoid probabilities. The decoder is symmetric, and validation edges currently remain in message passing; both conditions matter when interpreting metrics.

rows.zh: 以整张图为预测对象，通过图级表示预测一个或多个标签的任务。
rows.en: A task that predicts one or more labels for an entire graph using a graph-level representation.

rows.zh: task=graph_classification 使用独立多图数据集：HIV 为单个二分类任务，PCBA 为 128 个二分类任务。节点消息传递后进行图级读出；整图标签与同一图中各节点的标签是不同监督对象。
rows.en: task=graph_classification uses a separate multi-graph dataset: one binary task for HIV and 128 binary tasks for PCBA. Node message passing is followed by graph-level readout. A graph label and labels of individual nodes are different supervision targets.

text.zh: 术语参考：以下官方文档用于核对中英文表达。各术语在 iGraph 中的具体数据结构、算法选项和运行边界，以本项目相应技术章节为准。
text.en: Terminology references: the official documents below provide Chinese and English usage. iGraph's data structures, algorithm options, and runtime boundaries are defined in this project's corresponding technical chapters.

label.zh: DGL：整图分类、消息传递与图读出
label.en: DGL: graph classification, message passing, and readout

description.zh: 仅将本技术文档网站发布到 Cloudflare Workers 免费域名，不部署 iGraph 应用或后端。
description.en: Publish only this documentation website on a free Cloudflare Workers domain. The iGraph application and its backend are not deployed.

text.zh: 本站通过 Node.js 将双语内容构建为 HTML、CSS、JavaScript、搜索索引和 Markdown 文件。Cloudflare Workers Static Assets 直接分发这些文件，不需要应用 Worker 脚本、API 反向代理、数据库或登录服务。
text.en: Node.js builds the bilingual content into HTML, CSS, JavaScript, a search index, and Markdown files. Cloudflare Workers Static Assets serves them directly, without an application Worker script, API proxy, database, or login service.

rows.zh: 每版本 20,000 个；单文件 25 MiB
rows.en: 20,000 files per version; 25 MiB per file

rows.zh: 预生成各语言页面；未知路径返回真实 404
rows.en: Pre-generated localized pages; unknown paths return an actual 404

text.zh: 免费域名的账号子域名由 Cloudflare 账号决定。上述 URL 是格式示例，不代表本站已经在该地址发布。平台限制核对日期：2026-09-10。
text.en: The account subdomain is determined by your Cloudflare account. The URL above illustrates the format and does not claim this site is already live there. Platform limits checked on September 10, 2026.

text.zh: 使用 Node.js 22.12 或更高版本。所有命令在 docs-site 目录执行；npm ci 使用提交的 package-lock.json 安装固定版本 Wrangler。静态构建本身不需要 React 或项目 Python 依赖。
text.en: Use Node.js 22.12 or later. Run commands inside docs-site. npm ci installs the pinned Wrangler version from package-lock.json. The static build itself requires neither React nor the project’s Python dependencies.

blocks.code:
cd docs-site
npm ci
npm run build
npm run check
npm run dev

text.zh: 开发预览默认位于 http://127.0.0.1:4173。内容修改后重新运行 npm run build 并刷新页面。npm run preview 使用 Wrangler 本地运行环境。
text.en: The development preview defaults to http://127.0.0.1:4173. Re-run npm run build after content changes and refresh. npm run preview uses the local Wrangler runtime.

text.zh: 每个章节已经生成 index.html，所以使用静态目录路由和 404-page，不需要 SPA fallback。省略 main 和 run_worker_first，使正常文档请求直接由静态资产服务处理。
text.en: Each chapter has a generated index.html. Static directory routing and 404-page are sufficient; no SPA fallback is needed. Omitting main and run_worker_first lets normal documentation requests go directly to the asset service.

blocks.code:
npx wrangler login
npx wrangler whoami
npm run deploy:check
npm run deploy

text.zh: 首次登录需要在浏览器完成 Cloudflare 授权。部署成功后，以 Wrangler 输出的真实 workers.dev URL 为准。检查中英文页面、章节深链接、404、搜索、代码复制和移动端目录。更新内容时再次运行 deploy，静态资产随版本一起发布。
text.en: The first login requires Cloudflare authorization in your browser. After deployment, use the actual workers.dev URL printed by Wrangler. Check both languages, chapter deep links, 404s, search, copying, and mobile navigation. Run deploy again to publish updated content and its assets as one version.

text.zh: 如需 sitemap，得到真实域名后设置 SITE_URL 再构建和部署。构建器会拒绝带路径或非 HTTPS 的站点地址。
text.en: For a sitemap, set SITE_URL to the real origin, then rebuild and deploy. The builder rejects non-HTTPS URLs and URLs containing a path.

text.zh: 仓库附带独立 docs-site.yml 工作流。Pull request 构建并检查文档；正式发布由手动 workflow_dispatch 触发。配置 GitHub Secrets 中的 CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN 和 CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID，并可选设置仓库变量 DOCS_SITE_URL。此工作流只上传 docs-site/dist。
text.en: The repository includes a separate docs-site.yml workflow. Pull requests build and validate docs; production deployment is triggered manually through workflow_dispatch. Configure GitHub secrets CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and, optionally, the repository variable DOCS_SITE_URL. Only docs-site/dist is uploaded.

text.zh: 也可使用 Cloudflare Workers Builds：Root directory 为 docs-site，Build command 为 npm run build，Deploy command 为 npx wrangler deploy。选定一种生产发布方式，避免两个流水线同时更新同一个站点。
text.en: Alternatively, use Cloudflare Workers Builds with Root directory docs-site, Build command npm run build, and Deploy command npx wrangler deploy. Choose one production publishing mechanism to avoid competing deployments.

blocks.code:
npx wrangler deployments list
npx wrangler rollback VERSION_ID --message "Restore previous docs release"

text.zh: 回滚会将线上部署切换到所选历史版本，但不会修改本地内容。记录部署版本 ID、内容来源提交和发布日期；回滚后同步修正源文件，再正常发布。
text.en: Rollback switches the live deployment to a selected historical version without changing local content. Record deployment version IDs, source commits, and publication dates. Correct the source after a rollback before publishing again.

description.zh: 从具体症状定位问题：运行环境、权限、图构建、流式恢复，以及文档站发布。
description.en: Diagnose concrete symptoms across runtime setup, permissions, construction, stream recovery, and documentation publishing.

rows.zh: 填写 IGRAPH_CONTROL_SERVICE_KEY，四服务使用相同非空值；修改后同步重启。
rows.en: Set the same non-empty IGRAPH_CONTROL_SERVICE_KEY in all four services; restart them together after changes.

rows.zh: 工作台请求 API 失败
Vite 当前开发代理是 1109，而 .env.example 的 Backend 是 21109；本地开发需对齐代理端口或设置 VITE_API_BASE。Compose 已提供独立反代。
rows.en: The current Vite dev proxy targets 1109, while .env.example uses Backend 21109. Align the proxy or VITE_API_BASE for local development. Compose provides its own proxy.

rows.zh: 未配置嵌入模型时只关闭 LearnedKnowledge，其他已列出的记忆能力仍可使用。
rows.en: Without embedding configuration, only LearnedKnowledge is disabled; the other documented memory features remain available.

items.zh: algorithm_available 为 false：检查输入类型与算法注册。当前 CSV / TXT / SQL 均有内置 builder。
items.en: algorithm_available is false: check input type and registration. Built-in builders exist for CSV, TXT, and SQL.

items.zh: LLM 模式缺少凭据：配置构图或供应商 Key / Base URL；关系型输入需要离线基线时显式选 rules。entities 必须使用 LLM，不能降级为 rules。
items.en: LLM credentials missing: configure construction/provider keys and base URL, or explicitly select rules for an offline relational baseline. entities requires an LLM and cannot fall back to rules.

items.zh: 输入限制或解析失败：核对 UTF-8 编码、TXT/CSV 分隔符和列数、SQLite 语法及源文件大小；entities 还需核对字符、分块、模型调用和图规模上限。系统不会静默截断超限输入，也不会发布部分分块的半图。
items.en: Input limit or parsing failure: check UTF-8 encoding, TXT/CSV delimiters and column counts, SQLite syntax, and source size. For entities, also inspect character, chunk, model-call, and graph-size limits. Oversized input is not silently truncated, and completed chunks are not published as a partial graph.

items.zh: 版本冲突：读取最新 revision，重新预览编辑再提交。
items.en: Revision conflict: read the latest revision and preview edits again before committing.

text.zh: 先区分观察连接关闭与 Run 终止。同页面断流保留消息并从已应用游标续接；刷新丢失消息则从 -1 暂存重建。遇到 REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE 时等待完整快照；resume_cursor 为 null 时不要把快照与旧游标增量混用。start_request_id 使用 UUID，且同一次请求的重试保持相同 ID。
text.en: Distinguish observer disconnection from run termination. Keep messages and resume from the applied cursor on same-page disconnects; rebuild from -1 after losing message state. On REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE, wait for a complete snapshot. Never combine a snapshot with old-cursor deltas when resume_cursor is null. Use a UUID start_request_id and retain it across retries of the same request.

text.zh: 代理需要流式转发并关闭响应缓冲。取消是否完成以 execution_stopped 和 terminal_persisted 为准；浏览器断开不代表后端计算停止。
text.en: Proxies must stream responses without buffering. Use execution_stopped and terminal_persisted to determine whether cancellation has completed. A browser disconnect does not imply backend computation has stopped.
